Title: Diagnosis of test `testGenerateURLFragment`
Details: The test `testGenerateURLFragment` checks whether HTML entities such as `"` are correctly escaped to their corresponding character by the `StandardToolTipTagFragmentGenerator.generateToolTipFragment` method. However, the test failure indicates that this is not the case. Following the execution path, we find that `StandardToolTipTagFragmentGenerator.generateToolTipFragment` is not escaping any HTML code; instead, it is using its input `toolTipText` as is. Consequently, un-escaped strings are being returned, which leads to the error demonstrated by the test.

The test `['org.apache.commons.csv.CSVParserTest.testExcelHeaderCountLessThanData()']` failed.
The test looks like:

```java
377 :     @Test
378 :     public void testExcelHeaderCountLessThanData() throws Exception {
379 :         final String code = "A,B,C,,\r\na,b,c,d,e\r\n";
380 :         final CSVParser parser = CSVParser.parse(code, CSVFormat.EXCEL.withHeader()); // error occurred here
390 :     }
```

It failed with the following error message and call stack:

```
java.lang.IllegalArgumentException: The header contains a duplicate name: "" in [A, B, C, , ]
	at org.apache.commons.csv.CSVParser.initializeHeader(CSVParser.java:367)
	at org.apache.commons.csv.CSVParser.<init>(CSVParser.java:248)
	at org.apache.commons.csv.CSVParser.parse(CSVParser.java:178)
	at org.apache.commons.csv.CSVParserTest.testExcelHeaderCountLessThanData(CSVParserTest.java:380)
```

Start by calling the `get_failing_tests_covered_classes` function.

The error message indicates that the problem is with the header initialization in the CSVParser class, specifically because of a duplicate empty header name: "".

The test `testExcelHeaderCountLessThanData` calls `CSVParser.parse(String, CSVFormat)` with a CSV string that has a header line "A,B,C,," (two trailing commas implying empty header names).

The stack trace shows the error is thrown from `CSVParser.initializeHeader()` which is called by the constructor `CSVParser(java.io.Reader, CSVFormat)` during parsing.

Step 1: The `parse` method is called with the input string and CSVFormat.EXCEL.withHeader(), which means the header is assumed from the first row.

Step 2: Parsing starts, the first line is read as header "A,B,C,,"

Step 3: `initializeHeader` is called to set up the header names and validate them.

Step 4: `initializeHeader()` finds a duplicate header name "" (the empty string) due to the two trailing commas, and throws IllegalArgumentException.

So the cause is that the CSV input header contains empty header names, and the code does not allow duplicate header names (including empty string).

Next, I want to check the `CSVParser.initializeHeader()` code to see how it processes and validates the header names and identify why it fails on empty names, or if empty names are handled at all.

Based on the available information, provide the signatures of the most likely culprit methods for the bug. Your answer will be processed automatically, so make sure to only answer with the accurate signatures of all likely culprits (in `ClassName.MethodName(ArgType1, ArgType2, ...)` format), without commentary (one per line).
